limits: Timings include process startup, runtime argument parsing and output, not isolated kernels.
Charged managed bytes exclude allocator metadata and private native buffers; AD profiles count those buffers separately.
Lazy producer tails still dispatch and allocate; runtime State update callbacks may dispatch.
Zero warm native workspace allocations still require one managed gradient result array.
Cold/warm O1/O2 gradients agree with tracing enabled or compiled out; oversized workspace buffers are released.
The full native Linux ARM baseline exposed a GCC conservative-root omission-control issue subsequently fixed and checked in run 38373379103.
Windows and general tracing-free execution remain deferred.
